sections.heading: ### 🧠 cognitive augmentation
sections.note: humans are augmenting themselves with bespoke software, to massive effect. there has never been a better time to learn how to do augment yourself, nor more to gain. here I'm sharing some of the tools I'm using to augment myself.

projects.name: cody's skills
projects.line: sharing my cognitive heuristics. the ways I talk to my computer.

projects.name: cody's stack
projects.line: awesome software i think more people should be aware of

sections.heading: ### ⚙️ my bespoke software
sections.note: here are some tools I've built to solve some of my own problems. I'm sharing them below:

projects.name: pi-antigravity-hud
projects.line: live color-coded 5-hour and weekly quota meters for Antigravity models in Pi.

projects.name: YouTube Playlist Search
projects.line: I needed to add videos to the right playlists, past YouTube's 200 cap

projects.name: Webpage Summarizer
projects.line: I needed to quickly summarize only a chunk of the page's text

projects.name: Spotify Notes
projects.line: I needed to take notes on music for DJ library curation

projects.name: Manic Spending Buddy
projects.line: I needed to stop making frivolous Amazon purchases

projects.name: Flur
projects.line: I needed an affordable open-source are.na for my design taste

projects.name: Cody's New Tab
projects.line: I needed my tabs organized against ADHD

projects.name: Dark Mode Anywhere
projects.line: I needed dark mode on every site. covers 100% of the web.

projects.name: Not A Financial Advisor
projects.line: I needed to budget without paying $200/yr for YNAB

projects.name: Notes for Amazon List
projects.line: I needed to remember why I saved that item

projects.name: Amazon List Search
projects.line: I needed to quickly add items to the right Amazon list

sections.heading: ### 🚀 building your own bespoke software
sections.note: I've built pipelines that build pipelines. Here I'm sharing some tools I've built to remove frustrating obstacles I've encountered to building (& sharing) things:

projects.name: create-claude-plugin
projects.line: end-to-end scaffold for building, testing, & publishing Claude Code plugins

projects.name: create-chrome-extension
projects.line: end-to-end scaffold for building, testing, & publishing Chrome extensions

projects.name: herdr-chrome-keys
projects.line: Chrome-style keybindings for herdr, plus the Ghostty profile that makes them work on macOS
projects.term:
cmd     →  workspace   one per project
ctrl    →  tab         inside a workspace
prefix  →  pane        splits inside a tab

projects.name: create-github-repo
projects.line: end-to-end scaffold for publishing GitHub repos

projects.name: create-mac-app
projects.line: end-to-end scaffold for building, testing, & publishing macOS apps on the App Store
